title: Graph Execution Core
summary: This module defines the fundamental components for building, executing, and managing directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) or cyclic graphs with state. It provides abstractions for nodes, graph definition, runtime execution, path construction, and parallel processing.

nodes.label: Define Graph Node
nodes.title: BaseNode
nodes.description: Abstract base for all graph components, defining execution logic and next steps. It provides methods for node identification and defining potential transitions to other nodes or graph termination.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Graph Definition
nodes.title: Graph
nodes.description: Manages the collection of nodes, validates connections, and provides methods to run or visualize the graph. It orchestrates the overall graph definition and execution lifecycle.

nodes.label: Execute Graph Flow
nodes.title: GraphRun
nodes.description: Manages the stateful, asynchronous execution of a graph, iterating through nodes and handling state persistence. It allows for step-by-step execution or full completion.

nodes.label: Capture Graph Output
nodes.title: GraphRunResult
nodes.description: Stores the final output, state, and execution history of a completed graph run. It provides access to the graph's outcome and its final internal state.

nodes.label: Define Atomic Step
nodes.title: Step
nodes.description: Encapsulates a single function call or operation as an executable unit within a graph path. It defines an atomic action with specific inputs and outputs.

nodes.label: Synchronize Parallel Paths
nodes.title: Join
nodes.description: Aggregates results from multiple parallel execution branches using a reducer function. It synchronizes parallel paths and combines their outputs into a single result.

nodes.label: Construct Graph Paths
nodes.title: PathBuilder
nodes.description: Provides a fluent API to declaratively build complex execution paths with transformations, forks, and joins. It simplifies the construction of sequential and parallel graph flows.

nodes.label: Analyze Fork-Join Structure
nodes.title: ParentForkFinder
nodes.description: Identifies dominating forks for join nodes to ensure correct parallel execution and prevent deadlocks. It analyzes graph structure to manage complex concurrency patterns.

nodes.label: Persist Graph State
nodes.title: BaseStatePersistence
nodes.description: Handles saving and loading the graph's state and current node during execution. It ensures that graph runs can be paused, resumed, or recovered across sessions.

groups.label: Core Abstractions
groups.title: Core Abstractions
groups.description: Fundamental building blocks for defining graph components and their behavior.

groups.label: Graph Definition
groups.title: Graph Definition
groups.description: Components responsible for defining the structure and paths within a graph.

groups.label: Execution Logic
groups.title: Execution Logic
groups.description: Units that represent atomic operations and mechanisms for combining parallel execution flows.

groups.label: Runtime Management
groups.title: Runtime Management
groups.description: Manages the dynamic execution flow, state, and lifecycle of a graph run.

groups.label: Analysis & Output
groups.title: Analysis & Output
groups.description: Components for analyzing graph structure and capturing the final results of an execution.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Dependencies
groups.description: Interfaces with external systems for state management during graph execution.
